en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Abu Najran, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Muhammad from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn abu Najran from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Kidney beans dispel gases from the belly.’”
